pages.text: Mobs are tougher and smarter. Mutant Monsters wander rarely and are not ordinary zombies. Mowzie's and Cataclysm creatures guard places that look like they should be guarded.$(br2)Combat is Better Combat: directional swings, real reach. Spartan Weaponry gives spears, halberds and crossbows a reason to exist; Old Guns gives you a musket if you can make powder.

$(bold)Dogs$(): tame a wolf, then feed it a $(bold)Training Treat$() to make it a dog (Doggy Talents). Dogs learn talents, carry things, fight well and come back. Whistle commands are on $(bold)Shift+1..4$().$(br2)Your corpse keeps your items when you die (Corpse). Walk back.
